summary: Recent updates in the session negotiation area of Firefox have addressed a latent off-by-one bug in the Session Description Protocol (SDP), which is crucial for managing media sessions in technologies like WebRTC, the backbone of video calling and real-time communication. Fixing this bug helps ensure that media data is handled more accurately during negotiations, leading to a more reliable and efficient connection setup. While users may not notice any immediate changes, this fix contributes to smoother performance and stability in applications that rely on real-time media.
